sourceChecks.title: Comparison of 162 mg and 81 mg Aspirin for Prevention of Preeclampsia: A Randomized Controlled Trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: the rates of preterm preeclampsia or preeclampsia with severe features were similar
sourceChecks.paraphrase: High-risk pregnancy dose-comparison trial found similar preeclampsia composite rates for 162 mg versus 81 mg aspirin; 365 participants had delivery data. It does not test either dose against no aspirin or establish universal prevention/cure.
sourceChecks.limitations: Trial does not establish a cure or prevention across hypertensive disorders; confidence interval included no difference.

sourceChecks.title: Cerclage in singleton pregnancies with no prior spontaneous preterm birth and short cervix: a randomized controlled trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: There was no significant difference in the primary outcome
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Early-halted 90-patient analysis of cerclage plus progesterone versus progesterone alone found no significant reduction in birth before 35 weeks, but reported 13-day median increased delivery latency in this selected population.
sourceChecks.limitations: Selected risk group, small sample; not a universal mechanism or >90% prevention.

sourceChecks.title: Nonhormonal therapy for endometriosis: a randomized, placebo-controlled, pilot study of cabergoline versus norethindrone acetate
sourceChecks.excerpt: We observed a decrease in pain scores
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Nine-woman randomized pilot reported decreased pain scores and no serious adverse events with cabergoline.
sourceChecks.limitations: Very small pilot; symptom relief does not demonstrate lesion eradication, infertility reversal, recurrence prevention, immediate reversibility, or zero side effects.

sourceChecks.title: Impact of human ovarian tissue manipulation on follicles: evidence of a potential first wave of follicle activation during fertility preservation procedures
sourceChecks.excerpt: Fresh ovarian tissue was retrieved from 9 women
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Ex-vivo tissue from nine women showed processing-associated changes in PI3K/Hippo follicle-activation markers.
sourceChecks.limitations: Ex-vivo tissue marker study; does not restore ovarian endocrine function, reverse menopause, extend reproductive life, or establish safety/cancer risk.

sourceChecks.title: Layered precision suturing vs. traditional double-layer closure at cesarean: a randomized trial of uterine scar healing and maternal outcomes
sourceChecks.excerpt: LP closure with quantified tension improved 6-month uterine scar healing
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Single-center 500-randomized-participant trial reported lower six-month ultrasound-defined poor healing with layered precision suturing; 425 had primary outcome data. No scarless uterus, long-term rupture elimination or organ regeneration demonstrated.
sourceChecks.limitations: Ultrasound surrogate and six-month follow-up; no scarless healing, full biomechanical restoration, future rupture reduction, or accreta outcomes established.

sourceChecks.title: Fetal programming of polycystic ovary syndrome: Effects of androgen exposure on prenatal ovarian development
sourceChecks.excerpt: Pregnant dams were injected with dihydrotestosterone on days 16-18 of pregnancy.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Prenatal androgen-exposure mouse experiment found altered neonatal ovarian expression and mitochondrial function. Proposed pathway is model-specific, not a proven universal human PCOS cause or cure.
sourceChecks.limitations: Animal model and induced phenotype do not establish the human root cause or a curative treatment.

sourceChecks.title: Safety and pharmacokinetics of the non-hormonal male contraceptive YCT-529
sourceChecks.excerpt: Overall, YCT-529 was well tolerated in this single ascending dose study
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Sixteen male volunteers received single ascending doses in phase1a safety/pharmacokinetic testing; no contraceptive efficacy or post-treatment fertility-recovery result was tested.
sourceChecks.limitations: Single-dose safety/pharmacokinetics did not test contraceptive efficacy, reversibility, libido, semen recovery, or long-term health.

sourceChecks.title: UKCTOCS
sourceChecks.excerpt: Screening in UKCTOCS did not reduce deaths due to ovarian and tubal cancer.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Official trial-team page reports no ovarian/tubal cancer mortality reduction from CA125/ultrasound screening, despite earlier detection; motivates different early-detection approaches.
sourceChecks.limitations: Institutional summary rather than primary article; does not demonstrate a stage-I biomarker with >95% sensitivity/specificity or prevention intervention.

sourceChecks.title: Towards a bioengineered uterus: bioactive sheep uterus scaffolds are effectively recellularized by enzymatic preconditioning
sourceChecks.excerpt: all the uterus scaffolds exhibited growth factor activity that promoted neurogenesis and angiogenesis.
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Sheep uterus decellularization and in-vitro recellularization study found bioactive scaffolds and improved cell seeding with enzymatic preconditioning; future in-vivo sheep grafts are the next step, not demonstrated pregnancy-supporting organs.
sourceChecks.limitations: Animal tissue scaffold/in-vitro work does not show transplantation, vascularized innervated organ, gestation, term pregnancy, or human applicability.

items.corrections: A high-risk pregnancy aspirin dose-comparison trial found similar preeclampsia rates at 162 versus 81 mg. This is a narrow comparative clinical result, with no no-aspirin arm and no universal prevention or cure demonstrated.

An early-halted trial found no significant reduction in the primary preterm-birth rate but 13-day median increased latency with cerclage plus progesterone in a selected short-cervix group. Universal preterm-birth prevention is not established.
Small randomized pilot evidence suggests nonhormonal cabergoline may reduce endometriosis-associated pain; it did not show a cure.

No inspected primary page substantiates the exact 5–6-week, every-genetic-condition, >99%-accuracy blood test. The bounded search outcome is unsupported rather than positively backed background; this is not disproof.
Human ovarian tissue studies show measurable follicle-activation signaling after manipulation, a narrow experimental result rather than restored ovarian function.
A randomized trial reported improved six-month ultrasound healing metrics with a precision suturing method; full scarless uterine regeneration was not shown.
An animal androgen-exposure model offers mechanistic observations about PCOS-like traits, not proof of a human root cause or cure.
A first-in-human single-dose study evaluated the safety and pharmacokinetics of YCT-529, not contraceptive efficacy or reversibility.
The UKCTOCS randomized screening program directly tested ovarian-cancer screening; its trial report says screening did not reduce mortality despite earlier detection.
Animal scaffold work demonstrated an in-vitro tissue-engineering step, not a transplantable uterus supporting pregnancy.

notes: All nine positive URLs independently reopened and actual titles/topics/result passages matched.
OBG-04 had no read supporting page and even its claims were unsupported; corrected overall background-only to unsupported.

Aspirin dose comparison does not establish efficacy versus no aspirin; cerclage primary outcome null with narrower latency result, nine-person endometriosis pilot, mouse PCOS model, and single-dose male safety trial remain narrowly described.
Every evidence supportedClaim is specific to the single page, with unsupported universal/impact assertions separately retained.
